To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the personality construct is the key factor in the security behaviour of employees, and the neutralization technique is the key factor that influences their security behaviour.

1) Compliance based security is not enough to ensure security, 2) Personality traits of employees play a vital role in ensuring security and 3) Neutralization techniques used by employees to justify violation of security protocols can be used to reduce security violations.

(1) the link between cybersecurity protocol violation and the rationalisation of employees' behaviour can be explained by personality traits and neutralization techniques, and (2) the personality traits and neutralisation techniques can be used to predict the likelihood of cybersecurity protocol violation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the personality of an employee and their rationalisation of security behaviour can influence their compliance to cybersecurity protocol.
how to reduce the risk of security breaches and improve compliance based security.
the role of individual security scenario in security compliance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
compliance-based security can be enhanced through the inclusion of the 'Big Five' personality construct and the 'neutralization theory'.
the findings of the current study are significant in terms of providing a new perspective on compliance based information security.
, the proposed model can be applied to other industries, and the findings of this work can help to improve information security management in banking organizations and other industries.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

compliance based security is not sufficient for achieving information security, and that a combination of compliance based security and individual security scenario effect would be a more effective security model.
, in order to achieve a better level of information security, it is essential to take into account the personality traits and neutralization theory as well as the security scenario effect.
, in order to improve the effectiveness of compliance based security, it should be complemented with a more comprehensive security awareness program that addresses the individual security scenarios.
The main takeaway from our work is that
compliance based security is a double edged sword. It provides a false sense of security, but also creates a false sense of invincibility.
the security compliance is a necessary, but not a sufficient condition for ensuring security.
security compliance is not a panacea for information security and that the security of information systems can be enhanced through the use of complementary security measures.
